# Profile parser representative fixtures

These eight profiles are synthetic, sanitized examples written for deterministic
parser regression coverage. They are not LinkedIn recordings and must not be
reported as real-profile acceptance evidence. `gold.json` supplies an explicit
16-field denominator (one title and one company per profile).

The M3 real-profile acceptance metric remains a manual blocker until the project
has a consented, non-private recorded corpus that can be evaluated without
committing personal profile data.
